explication: Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL is an EF Core provider that translates LINQ and update operations into PostgreSQL-compatible commands, executes them through Npgsql, and maps results to .NET values. Applications configure the provider through DbContext options or dependency injection. The core workflow spans service registration, query translation, SQL generation, connection/data-source management, and PostgreSQL execution. Optional NetTopologySuite and NodaTime packages add spatial and temporal mappings/translators. Design-time services also support database reverse engineering. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime code; some EF Core-internal orchestration is necessarily represented externally.
